newsitem.title: ITALY: Finmeccanica posts 540.4 bln lire loss.
newsitem.headline: Finmeccanica posts 540.4 bln lire loss.

text.p: Note: Finmeccanica, the engineering, aerospace and defence arm of state holding IRI, said it had made an extraordinary writedown of 575 billion lire in 1996 ahead of one-off charges for defence and aeronautic operations.

Note: Finmeccanica said the need for the extrordinary writedown arose from the demands for a more decisive policy of alliances. It said mergers in the U.S. defence and aeronautics sectors meant that European companies would also have to join forces to compete against U.S. competitors.
"Finmeccanica has to swiftly become actively involved in these alliances with a role which will be as high profile as its profitability," a statement said.
It said its main goals were international alliances and privatisation,
Finmeccanica said it expected a return to profitability this year, barring any further extraordinary items. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
